name: A Hero's Reward
label: Quest
description: A Hero's Reward: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, your services to the Warlords surpassed all we could expect from the denizens of this world.
We do not understand your people's notions of gratitude, or rewarding good works, but in this case... Perhaps a reward is warranted.
Under the surf at the southern base of this island, you will find a coffer. In it you will find your... Reward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hydraxis' voice descends from the waters' surface...
"Choose that which best suits you, friend. May it protect you against the foes of the Waterlords."
